details: Bitcoin briefly surpassed $83,000 before settling at $81,844 on Monday, supported by falling U.S. Treasury yields and lower oil prices. Despite the price rebound, investor demand remains a concern, with U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recording a net outflow of $228.4 million last week and $82.4 million on October 16 alone. Analysts caution that increased leveraged bets could lead to further liquidations if prices drop below $80,000.
title: Bitcoin Rebounds to $81,844, But Demand Remains Weak Amid ETF Outflows

details: JPMorgan has expanded its JPM Coin, a USD deposit token, to the Ethereum mainnet for institutional clients as of October 19, 2026. This move, following its initial deployment on the Base network, aims to offer multi-chain flexibility for wholesale money movement, leveraging Ethereum's extensive liquidity and institutional activity within its ecosystem.
title: JPMorgan Launches JPM Coin on Ethereum Mainnet for Institutional Clients

details: U.S. Ethereum ETFs have experienced substantial outflows for three consecutive weeks, shedding $320 million in just one week and erasing approximately 62% of their 2026 inflows by their September peak. This sharp decline in investor interest, which outpaces Bitcoin ETF outflows, has contributed to ETH being down 18.9% year-to-date, raising questions about Wall Street's sustained appetite for Ethereum.
title: Ethereum ETFs See Significant Outflows, Wiping Out 62% of 2026 Inflows

details: Hong Kong has officially acknowledged Bitcoin and Ethereum as valid proof of wealth for its Capital Investment Entrant Scheme (CIES) investment visa program. This significant regulatory development could attract substantial capital flows into the region, potentially driving up BTC and ETH prices by signaling a major governmental shift towards mainstream crypto adoption.
title: Hong Kong Recognizes Bitcoin & Ethereum for Investment Visas

details: The CME Group commenced the introduction of Bitcoin Cash (BCH) and Uniswap (UNI) futures on October 19, 2026. This initiative provides institutional derivatives traders with regulated avenues to access these cryptocurrency markets, offering standard and micro contracts. The new products enable market participants to manage price exposure without direct custody of the underlying tokens, catering to a growing demand for advanced risk-management tools.
title: CME Launches Bitcoin Cash and Uniswap Futures on October 19

details: U.S. spot XRP exchange-traded funds concluded a 13-week streak of inflows by registering a modest $1.84 million in net withdrawals between October 12-16. This reversal is accompanied by a significant 72.3% drop in XRP Ledger payment volume, which fell to 119.5 million XRP on October 17, signaling a potential cooling of investor interest and network activity for the token.
title: XRP ETFs Record First Outflows in 13 Weeks Amid Falling On-Chain Activity
